deep_analysis:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
TRADE WATCHDOG — GOOD
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════

Open Trades: 2 (0 long, 2 short) — CHIP + MET, both volume-buildup-
Unrealized PnL: -0.02 USDT (both <15min old, flat)
Regime: STRONG_DOWN (bear) | Volatility: LOW
BTC: 80215 vs 1m EMA300 80611 (-0.49%), 61 consecutive closes
     below, 1m RSI 41 (recovered from ~6 knife at 14:18),
     5m RSI 30. zscore -1.79 STRONG_NEG, velocity SLOW.
Sources: watchdog 15m/4h SHORT_BIAS; regime_5m 14:30 aggregate
         SHORT_BIAS 94/129; continuum BELOW (duration 61m),
         linreg 1m/5m/15m/1h all BEAR (alignment 1.0).
Flips/24h: aggregate 23, BTC 15 — normal churn (p50 19, p95 26;
           neither ≥26 flag nor <6 real-trend-tape condition met).

── Steers ──────────────────────────────────────────
🟡 [regime] Bias stays SHORT — conditions re-verified at 14:44
   (BTC below EMA300 ✓ 61 min, aggregate SHORT_BIAS ✓ 94/129 at
   14:30, continuum BELOW ✓). age=2 cycles unexecuted.
   Flip-back trigger: 1m BTC closes hold ABOVE EMA300 ~80611 for
   15-30m, OR aggregate LONG_BIAS 4+ consecutive dumps.
   Source of "SHORT": watchdog 15m + regime_5m aggregate + 1m
   linreg — all three agree this cycle.

🟢 [regime] RESOLVED — prior "no-new-entries / stay flat through
   the knife" gate. Its stated condition (1m holds below EMA300
   for 15m) was satisfied ~14:26; BTC has now held below for 61
   consecutive closes. Gate lifted; CHIP/MET opened 14:44 after
   it lifted, which is consistent. Not re-issued as urgent.

🟡 [cluster] CHIP + MET is ONE risk, not two. Same signal, both
   alts, opened 4 min apart, 100% net short. Correlation helps
   while BTC stays below EMA300 and hurts all at once if it
   reclaims. Condition to act: if 1m BTC closes hold ABOVE 80611
   for 15-30m, exit or tighten BOTH — do not manage them as
   independent trades.

🟡 [profit_lock] Neither short has armed the trail (needs -0.40%
   move: CHIP 0.041718, MET 0.307744). 7d exit families say this
   is the whole trade: trail/tp family 51T 44W +3.96 vs no-trail
   family 52T 0W -4.62. If neither reaches trail-arm by ~45-60m
   with MFE still <0.20%, that is the documented loser shape —
   MFE-CUT shadow is already collecting exactly this case.
   Action: manual exit preferred over waiting for the SL side.

🟡 [health] CHIP bracket is the weak one: SL 0.042933 = -2.50%
   risk vs TP 0.041258 = +1.50% reward → R:R 0.60, breakeven WR
   62.5%, while 7d volume-buildup- SHORT runs 58.3% (12T 7W).
   Negative EV if it resolves at the nominal bracket. MET is
   0.93 R:R (breakeven 51.5%) — acceptable. Action: raise CHIP
   SL to ~0.04240 (R:R 1.1, risk 1.23%) or accept that the trail
   — not the TP — must be the exit, in which case do not let the
   2.50% SL be the thing that resolves it.

🟢 [opportunity] AI pick written: SEI SHORT (precheck PASS all
   gates, CONF 80.8, 1m RSI 61.3, ATR 1.00%, no cooldown, 0 SEI
   trades in 7d) — PICK (watchlist only — AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False,
   will NOT execute). Supersedes LINK pick (10:20, 266min old,
   past 45min TTL).

── Deep Analysis ───────────────────────────────────
Both open shorts are on the right side of the tape and in the
one meta_rsi cell that pays on shorts: 7d SHORT >=60 = 7T 5W 71%
+0.72, vs SHORT 45-60 = 10T 20% -0.26. Entries at meta_rsi 63.0
(CHIP) and 63.3 (MET) are center-to-top of that winning cell, in
a STRONG_DOWN tape with BTC 61 min below EMA300 and all four
linreg slopes bearish. I would take both of these fresh today.

The exposure problem is structural, not directional: one BTC
reclaim of 80611 (+0.45%) bounces both alts simultaneously, and
CHIP's bracket only pays 0.60 per unit risk. The market is
currently giving us the right direction; our bracket sizing is
what can still lose it.

Watch item, not an action: a CHIP LONG pump-chain-v6+ signal is
sitting PENDING at 1m RSI 76.4, conf 88. Do not be tempted —
that is the exact overbought-long-in-a-down-tape shape that
cost us GRASS (-0.07, meta_rsi 60.8) and PUMP (-0.01, 65.3) in
the last 24h, and pump-chain-v6+ is 33% WR on n=3. Our short
side of CHIP is the better one.

── Recommendations ─────────────────────────────────
1. HOLD both shorts; single invalidation for the pair: 1m BTC
   closes hold above EMA300 ~80611 for 15-30m → exit both.
2. Fix the CHIP bracket (SL to ~0.04240 → R:R 1.1) or pre-commit
   to exiting on trail-arm failure at 45-60m with MFE<0.20%.
3. Do not open a third correlated alt short (3 alt shorts = one
   BTC bounce decides the whole book); slots stay open at 2/6.
4. SEI SHORT is on the watchlist only — no execution path while
   AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False; manual reference only.
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
